directSqlEventWriters.note: Direct SQL insert; not a recordEvent() callsite. Existing row is checked before insert and exact row is read back after insert. Enclosing transaction/caller contract must be traced separately.
directSqlEventWriters.writerBindingEvidence: run(eventId, jobId, APPROVAL_POLICY_OBSERVED_EVENT, JSON.stringify(payload), new Date(now).toISOString())
directSqlEventWriters.readbackEvidence: const persisted = workflowDb.prepare('SELECT event_id,job_id,type,payload_json FROM events WHERE event_id=?').get(eventId);

readerQueries.purpose: reconstruct policy high-water and reject malformed/reused versions
readerQueries.querySourceEvidence:
SELECT event_id,job_id,type,payload_json FROM events
    WHERE type=? AND json_extract(payload_json,'$.policy_id')=? ORDER BY rowid ASC

directSqlEventWriters.note: Direct SQL insert; not a recordEvent() callsite. Writer performs nonce precheck, inserts canonical serialized attestation, verifies/readbacks exact current source binding and execution-review readiness before caller transaction commits; invalid verification throws and rolls back caller transaction.
directSqlEventWriters.writerBindingEvidence: run(eventId, jobId, ADAPTIVE_GOAL_REVIEWER_ATTESTATION_EVENT, serialized, new Date(now).toISOString())
directSqlEventWriters.readbackEvidence: const verified = assertAdaptiveGoalReviewerAttestation(store, jobId, candidate, { now, trustConfigurationDb });

readerQueries.purpose: load exactly one reviewer attestation for the candidate job
readerQueries.querySourceEvidence:
SELECT event_id,job_id,type,payload_json FROM events
    WHERE job_id=? AND type=? ORDER BY created_at ASC,rowid ASC

readerQueries.purpose: require exactly one durable use of the reviewer attestation nonce
readerQueries.querySourceEvidence:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM events
    WHERE type=? AND json_extract(payload_json,'$.nonce')=?
